## Context
Story: 7cf8-84fc-c5ea-48ff — sprint shared scripts accept caller-specific prefixes and PR title/body

## Goal
Add --prefix <name> flag to plugins/dso/scripts/create-story-branch.sh (manual while-loop, default 'story'). Remove RED marker from .test-index.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## File Impact
| Source File | Action | Test File | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| plugins/dso/scripts/create-story-branch.sh | modify | tests/scripts/test-create-story-branch.sh | needs-modification |
| .test-index | modify | n/a | n/a |

## Implementation Steps
1. Open plugins/dso/scripts/create-story-branch.sh
2. After the shebang/comment block, add argument parsing using a manual while-loop (not getopt):
   - Initialize: PREFIX="story"
   - Loop: while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; case "$1" in --prefix) PREFIX="$2"; shift 2;; --prefix=*) PREFIX="${1#--prefix=}"; shift;; *) positional args...; shift;; esac; done
   - Accept --prefix anywhere in args list (before or after positional args)
3. Replace: _BRANCH="story/${_EPIC_ID}/${_STORY_ID}"
   With: _BRANCH="${_PREFIX:-story}/${_EPIC_ID}/${_STORY_ID}"
4. Replace: echo "STORY_BRANCH=${_BRANCH}" (both occurrences)
   — No change needed; variable name stays STORY_BRANCH regardless of prefix
5. Remove RED marker for create-story-branch.sh from .test-index

## Acceptance Criteria
- Script accepts --prefix <name> with manual while-loop (--prefix anywhere in args)
- Default behavior unchanged: no --prefix → branch uses 'story/' prefix
- STORY_BRANCH output uses the specified prefix
- RED marker removed from .test-index for create-story-branch.sh
- Running test suite: previously-RED tests now PASS (GREEN)
- bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0 (or only other RED tests fail)
- Script header Usage comment updated to document --prefix flag and default value
- ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
- ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
